name: Anchovy Herb Salsa Verde
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 9 cured anchovy fillets, drained, patted dry, and minced
6 tbsp finely-chopped fresh flat-leaf curly parsley

steps: In a small bowl, mix together all ingredients.
Serve with chips or grilled meat.

culture.text: In Mexican cuisine, salsa verde is a spicy green sauce made from tomatillo and green chili peppers. It dates to the Aztec Empire, as documented by the Spanish physician Francisco Hernández, and is distinct from the various medieval European parsley-based green sauces.
